epistemic_firewall: Brooklyn's lack of 1904-1905 records does not falsify 'Nahman & Co.' = Maurice Nahman.
Later documentation of Maurice Nahman does not retroactively prove the 1904 company form.
Morgan ca. 1920 provenance is a custody lead, not target-window identity evidence.
Smithsonian 1908-1909 records are near-temporal controls; only primary wording/letterhead/signature/address evidence may promote the identity gate.
Dealer-identity evidence does not establish object-level continuity between Bowdoin, Louvre, Mendes djed, CG 53469, or any Osiris relic candidate.

1909 consular seller Mr. M. Nahman and 1904 Nahman & Co. are similar shipping-era controls, but signature on 1909 declaration belongs to agents J. W. Congdon & Co., not independently proved to be Maurice Nahman.
Verified autograph of Maurice Nahman (1908) does not establish the exact Nahman & Co. firm in the reported 1904 Bowdoin certificate; independent document-level name/partners/address is still needed.

next_gate.name: NAHMAN_1904_1909_BUSINESS_IDENTITY_PRIMARY_DOCUMENT_GATE
next_gate.pass_condition: Primary document sufficiently close to 1904 binds Maurice Nahman to 'Nahman & Co.' or an equivalent company form, or independently binds the same address/signature/business entity.
next_gate.negative_condition: A source-exact contradictory identity or business record separates the 1904 'Nahman & Co.' entity from Maurice Nahman.
next_gate.unresolved_condition: Original March 1908 Maurice Nahman apparent autograph, contact address, itemized list and 1909 consular seller evidence all exist, but Bowdoin May 1904 original remains unseen and no document proves exact Nahman & Co. corporate/partner identity.
